preregistration: V4 — bounded synthesis continuation (frozen before first V4 model run)

implementation.review: APPROVED at head 92b9f99 (V4.1–V4.14 suite 14/14; suite 1794/0; tsc clean; CI green)

single_intervention.definition: ONE bounded tool-less continuation, available ONLY for a provider result on the FIRST synthesis completion (turn = E21 threshold+1, inside the frozen 24-turn cap) that terminates with stop_reason=max_tokens AND carries NON-EMPTY visible text AND carries ZERO tool requests. The continuation is one direct completeMultiTurn: same synthesis state (history + segment1 as the assistant turn + one frozen mechanism-generic instruction), tools: [], identical budget/sampling. The merged candidate (segment1+segment2, in order) enters the ordinary parse path with unchanged validators.
fail_closed_on: any non-terminal continuation state, including any tool request (independently of stop_reason)
zero-text synthesis truncation (nothing to continue — legacy failure; the attempt-19/V3-1-plan signature)
truncated first synthesis completion carrying tool requests (mixed state — dedicated diagnostic, no continuation call)
max_tokens on any LATER synthesis turn (e.g. after an ordinary format repair — legacy failure, never continued)
steps/turns outside the eligibility predicate or undeclared steps (byte-for-byte legacy)
single_intervention.evidence: <node>.synthesis-continuation.json persisted for every fired continuation (both segments VERBATIM, per-segment byte counts, continuation terminal state); never overwritten; preserved alongside the ordinary node outputs and archives

frozen_configuration.target: student-platform @ 86ec0871 + git clean -fdx before each run
frozen_configuration.per_completion_ceiling: unchanged — the continuation reuses the step's own budget; NO max_tokens raise anywhere
frozen_configuration.prompts: unchanged (normal stage instructions; no new emphasis, no V2/V3 failure-specific guidance, no continuation-specific coaching beyond the frozen mechanism instruction in code)
frozen_configuration.tools_policies: unchanged (E21 gate 18/19, E23 compaction 49152 B newest-first, worker-only positive EditPolicy, planning_depth minimal, max_iterations 5, on_cap_hit halt)
frozen_configuration.validators_oracle: unchanged (charter structure, producer contracts, Gate B, EXEC/validation)
frozen_configuration.workflow: unchanged (full-build; PR #47 structuralRepair declarations unchanged — scoping.produce/design/plan)

per_run_outcomes_frozen.truncation_observed: which stage(s), requested max_tokens, partial visible bytes, zero-text vs partial-text
per_run_outcomes_frozen.continuation_fired: true/false + ineligibility reason when false (zero-text / later-synthesis-turn / mixed tool state / policy-not-reached)
per_run_outcomes_frozen.continuation_adopted: merged candidate accepted by the ordinary parse+validators, or rejected with the ordinary reason
per_run_outcomes_frozen.structural_repair_invoked: unchanged V3 mechanism — expected false unless a completed output is structurally rejected (would be its first natural exercise)
per_run_outcomes_frozen.final_disposition: evaluable (model/workflow failure or success) | censored (per frozen definition) | implementation-defect (STOP)

hypotheses.H_V4_primary: The observed 3/3 V3 failure class (synthesis completion-capacity exhaustion at the E21 boundary) is convertible: a single tool-less continuation of a non-empty tool-less truncated first synthesis completion lets the stage complete through the unchanged validators.
hypotheses.H_V4_discrimination: Failures that persist under V4 will separate into (a) zero-text truncations (not continuable by design — tests whether the attempt-19 class is capacity or content), (b) second-truncations (one continuation insufficient — evidence for a capacity ceiling), (c) later-stage failures (the bottleneck moved), vs (d) full runs reaching completion.

stop_rules.censoring: genuinely transport-censored runs are archived/classified censored and do not consume an evaluable slot; continue per the frozen censoring rule
stop_rules.implementation_defect: evidence of an actual Stratum/V4 implementation defect STOPs the entire block immediately; preserve all evidence; no patch-and-continue
stop_rules.model_workflow_failure: including an invoked-and-failed continuation, is an evaluable result: archive, count, proceed — no tuning
stop_rules.do_not_stop_between_runs: interesting/surprising/successful/unsuccessful evaluable results do not pause the block

gate: no V4-1 execution until the operator reviews this preregistration and the recorded merge SHA
